description: This script automates the setup of a PostgreSQL database for a project, including creating extensions, tables, constraints, and indexes, primarily for managing team and weekly report data with a connection resolution strategy using environment variables and a config file.

methods.name: resolve_conn
methods.description: Resolves and outputs the database connection string from a file or environment variables.

calls: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.teams
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD CONSTRAINT profiles_role_check
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.weekly_reports
ALTER TABLE public.weekly_reports ADD CONSTRAINT weekly_reports_status_check
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_weekly_reports_author
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_weekly_reports_team
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_weekly_reports_status
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_profiles_email_lower
